description: ##The best way to explore the 10,000 Islands!
what_is_included:
Our 10,000 Islands tour departs daily from the Port of the Islands Marina just south of Marco Island off Rt 41. Embark on a laid-back 3-hour boat tour, navigating the scenic Faka Union Canal and exploring the beauty of the 10,000 Islands. Keep an eye out for the local wildlife, including the West Indian manatees, Atlantic bottlenose dolphins, American alligators, and the almost 200 bird species that call this area home.
As you soak in the surroundings, our knowledgeable guides will share fascinating insights about the intricate ecosystem, the diverse wildlife residing here, the historical significance of this area, and tales of the iconic Fakahatchee Island. This experience promises to deepen your appreciation for Florida's coastal wilderness, leaving you with memories of a peaceful and  informative exploration.


The trip will take place on a 45ft passenger catamaran with partial shade and bench seating.
what_to_bring:
Guests should consider bringing sunglasses, a hat, sunscreen, and water. Coolers and food are welcome
Snacks, Drinks, Beer, and Wine available for purchase at the marina ship store before departure.
